effect: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Once per short rest, after you hit with a melee attack, you can make one additional melee attack as a bonus action.

ds: A pale, featureless stone from Mysterious-realm caves that reflects the face of whoever looks at it, but never quite their own.
effect: Once per long rest, you can change your face and voice to look like any humanoid you have seen for 1 hour. Checks to see through the disguise have disadvantage.

ds: A brass-colored stone from Heaven's foundries, naturally formed in small cogs and ridges that turn slowly in its sockets.
effect: You gain +1 to checks made to build or repair devices. Once per short rest, you can make one mechanical trap, lock, or device within 30 feet activate or stop for 1 minute.

ds: A soft white stone streaked with pale green, found in Heaven's healing springs. Cracks in it slowly seal themselves overnight.
effect: Once per short rest, you touch a creature or object to restore 2d6 hit points or repair a broken item. Wounds you treat cannot reopen for 1 hour.

ds: A violet stone with a cloudy inner swirl, mined from Heaven's high plateaus. Thoughts seem to drift slower and clearer while holding it.
effect: You gain +1 to Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws. Once per short rest, you gain advantage on one Intelligence or Wisdom check or saving throw.

ds: A grey stone from the Inner Void whose color shifts to match its holder's feelings: blue for sorrow, red for fear, yellow for confusion.
effect: Once per long rest, you end the frightened, charmed, or confused condition on every creature within 60 feet, or impose one on a creature within 60 feet that fails a DC 19 Wisdom save for 1 minute.

ds: A smooth, milk-white stone found in Heaven's chapels, cool and calming to the touch. It dims slightly whenever blood is spilled near it.
effect: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you can leave it stable and unconscious instead. Once per long rest, a creature that surrenders to you regains 2d8 hit points.

ds: A pulsing red-orange stone from the Outer Realm that grows warmer as its holder exerts themselves, like a racing heartbeat trapped in rock.
effect: You need only half as much food and water. Once per short rest, you can spend a Hit Die as a bonus action, regaining twice the rolled hit points. You recover all Hit Dice on a long rest.

ds: A raw, molten-silver stone from the Primordial depths that never fully settles into a solid shape. It ripples when touched and rings like a bell.
effect: Your weapons count as magical and ignore resistance to slashing, piercing, and bludgeoning damage. Once per long rest, you reshape any metal object within 120 feet as you wish, or shatter it.

ds: A tiny stone, no bigger than a grain of sand, found in Human-realm silt. Under a lens it shows endless delicate patterns.
effect: Once per long rest, you can shrink yourself to Tiny size for 10 minutes, gaining +1 to Stealth checks and the ability to fit through any gap one inch wide.

ds: A banded brown and white stone found along Heaven's great trails, its stripes always pointing toward a distant warm place.
effect: Your speed increases by 5 feet. Once per long rest, you and up to six allies can travel twice as far as normal for 8 hours without gaining exhaustion.

ds: A radiant golden stone from the Inner Realm that glows brightest in moments of despair. Holy symbols placed near it seem to shine on their own.
effect: Once per long rest, when you or an ally within 60 feet would die, they instead regain 6d8 hit points and end all conditions. Your healing spells restore an extra 1d6 hit points.

ds: A soft, clay-brown stone from Heaven's riverbanks that holds any shape pressed into it, slowly returning to a smooth curve if left alone.
effect: You can reshape clay, stone, or soft metal by hand as if it were wet clay. Once per short rest, you can shape a 10-foot cube of earth into a wall, ramp, or stair.

ds: A pale silvery stone with a soft blue sheen, mined from Heaven's tide-pools. Its glow waxes and wanes with the moon above.
effect: You see in dim light as if it were bright light out to 60 feet. Once per short rest, you can push or pull a creature within 30 feet 15 feet, DC 14 Strength save negates.

ds: A small rounded stone from Mysterious-realm streambeds that never stays where it is placed, slowly rolling a few inches when no one watches.
effect: Your speed increases by 10 feet. Once per short rest, you can move up to your speed as a bonus action without provoking opportunity attacks.

ds: A damp, earthy brown stone from the Inner Void that never fully dries. It squishes slightly under pressure, then firms again.
effect: Once per long rest, you turn the ground in a 60-foot radius into deep mud for 1 minute. Creatures there are restrained unless they succeed on a DC 20 Strength save each turn.

ds: A small stone that always seems to have a twin beside it, found in Human-realm caves. Count a pile of them twice and you get two different numbers.
effect: Once per long rest, when you roll damage, you can double the result of one damage die.

ds: A dry, linen-colored stone from Chaos tombs, wrapped in natural fibrous layers and smelling faintly of resin and old spices.
effect: You have resistance to necrotic damage and cannot be aged. Once per long rest, a creature you hit is cursed: it cannot regain hit points for 1 minute, DC 16 Constitution save negates.

ds: A slender, ringing stone from Heaven's high echoing halls, it hums a different note depending on how it is struck.
effect: You gain +1 to Performance checks. Once per short rest, as a bonus action, allies within 30 feet who can hear you gain +1d6 to their next attack roll or saving throw.

ds: A dark, shimmering dust that clings together like a solid stone, found in the Outer Realm. It flows slowly through cracks and fingers.
effect: Once per long rest, you shrink to the size of a mote for 1 hour, becoming invisible to normal sight and immune to weapon attacks, though you cannot attack.

ds: A mossy green stone streaked with brown and blue, found in Human-realm forests. Small plants grow around it wherever it lies.
effect: You gain +1 to Nature and Survival checks. Once per long rest, you can speak with plants or animals for 10 minutes.

ds: A sickly grey-violet stone from the Inner Realm's graveyards. It feels cold and lifeless, and small bones sometimes shift near it.
effect: Once per long rest, you raise up to four corpses within 60 feet as undead servants for 1 hour. Your necrotic damage ignores resistance and deals an extra 1d6 once per turn.

ds: A matte black stone from the Outer Realm that absorbs light and sound alike. Magic seems to fizzle out against its dull surface.
effect: Once per short rest, as a reaction, you cancel a spell or magical effect targeting you or an ally within 60 feet. You have advantage on saves against magic.

ds: A thin, razor-edged stone from Hell, scored with countless tiny cuts that never quite close. It always draws a little blood when handled.
effect: When you hit with a melee attack, the target bleeds, taking 1d4 slashing damage at the start of each of its turns until healed. A creature can bear up to three such bleeds at once.

ds: A deep indigo stone flecked with faint silver, mined from Hell's lightless caverns. It is always cold and seems to swallow nearby light.
effect: You have darkvision out to 60 feet. Once per long rest, you can cover a 30-foot radius in magical darkness for 1 minute that only you can see through.

ds: A swirling, sickly purple stone from the Outer Realm that shows twisted dream-shapes in its depths. Sleeping near it brings terrible visions.
effect: Once per long rest, a creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom save or be frightened and take 4d6 psychic damage each turn for 1 minute.

ds: A dark grey stone from the Inner Void that is lifeless and dull by day but stirs with a pale glow once the sun sets.
effect: At night, you gain +10 feet of speed and +2 to attack rolls. Once per long rest, you raise a corpse within 30 feet as an undead servant until sunrise.

ds: A damp, grey-green stone from the Mysterious realm, cool and always faintly wet, as if a soft autumn wind passed over it.
effect: Once per short rest, you summon a damp wind in a 15-foot cone. Creatures there are pushed 10 feet and their flames are extinguished, DC 13 Strength save negates the push.

ds: A pale blue stone from Heaven that drains feeling from fingers that hold it too long, cold enough to make the skin tingle.
effect: Once per short rest, you ignore one source of pain, gaining 2d6 temporary hit points. A creature you hit must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution save or have disadvantage on its next attack.

ds: A soft, warm brown stone from Heaven's gardens. Flowers and young animals are drawn to it, and plants grow fuller nearby.
effect: Your healing restores an extra 1d6 hit points. Once per long rest, you bond with a beast within 30 feet; it becomes friendly to you for 24 hours.

ds: A dark red stone from the Outer Realm whose glow fixes on a single point and refuses to shift, no matter how it is turned.
effect: Choose one creature after a long rest. You gain +2 to attack rolls against it and always know its direction and distance within 1 mile.

ds: A glossy black stone with razor-sharp edges, found in Heaven's volcanic scars. It reflects light like dark water.
effect: Your melee attacks deal an extra 1d6 slashing damage. Once per short rest, a hit scores a critical on a roll of 19 or 20.

ds: A creamy, waxy stone from Chaos that leaves a soothing film on the skin. It smells of herbs and slowly sweats a thin oil.
effect: Once per short rest, you can apply its oil to a creature to restore 3d8 hit points and end one poison or disease. Creatures you heal gain resistance to poison for 1 hour.

ds: A crumbling grey stone from Hell, worn smooth by ages. It feels brittle and dry, and dust drifts off it constantly.
effect: Once per long rest, a creature you hit must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution save or have its speed halved and disadvantage on Strength checks for 1 minute.

ds: A small black-and-white stone from Human-realm crossroads, its pattern seeming to shift into warning shapes before danger comes.
effect: You cannot be surprised. Once per long rest, you gain +1d4 to one roll after seeing a sign of what is about to happen.

ds: A perfectly cubic white stone with clean, straight edges, mined from Heaven's halls. It always lands flat and square when dropped.
effect: Once per short rest, you can turn a d20 roll made within 30 feet into a 10. You have advantage on saves against confusion and madness.

ds: A living, slightly spongy green stone from the Human realm that grows tiny roots and slowly reaches toward water.
effect: You gain +1 to Constitution saves against poison and disease. Once per long rest, you regain 1d6 hit points as a bonus action.

ds: A smooth, swirling stone of every color, mined from Heaven's oldest bedrock. Each layer seems to point back to a single source.
effect: Once per long rest, you learn the true origin, creator, and history of one creature, object, or spell you touch. You also gain +2 to saves against magic from that source for 24 hours.

ds: A cracked, glowing red stone from the Outer Realm that pulses faster and faster when held, as if burning up its own life.
effect: Once per long rest, you gain one additional action on each of your next 3 turns. When it ends, you gain two levels of exhaustion.

ds: A red-black stone from Hell carved with faint signatures that change whenever someone makes a promise near it.
effect: Once per long rest, you can make a bargain with a willing creature: both must keep it or take 4d6 psychic damage when breaking it. You gain +1 to all rolls while honoring a pact.

ds: A raw, flayed-looking stone from Hell that stings when touched. Its surface burns with a dull red warmth.
effect: When you hit, the target takes an extra 1d6 psychic damage. Once per short rest, a creature you hit must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution save or be stunned until your next turn.

ds: A stone from the Abyss that is both hot and cold, light and heavy, depending on who holds it. Its shape refuses to settle.
effect: Once per long rest, you can make an attack or save both succeed and fail; you choose the result after seeing it. You take 2d6 psychic damage each time you use it.

ds: A pale, clinging stone from the Human realm that sticks to skin and slowly drains warmth from whoever holds it.
effect: Once per long rest, when you hit a creature, you drain 1d6 hit points from it and gain them as temporary hit points for 1 hour.

ds: A faded, sepia-toned stone from the Inner Realm that shows dim images of what once happened where it rests.
effect: Once per long rest, you rewind time 1 round: every creature within 60 feet returns to where it was and the hit points it had. You also learn what happened in a place in the last 24 hours.

ds: A small, soft-colored stone from Heaven that small animals love to nuzzle. It is always warm, like a sleeping creature.
effect: You gain a Tiny companion that obeys you. Once per short rest, it can grant you advantage on one Perception check or help an ally within 5 feet.

ds: A worn brown stone from Heaven, crusted with dried herbs and remedies, used by old healers before the church's methods.
effect: You gain +1 to Medicine checks. Once per short rest, you can heal a creature for 2d6 hit points with no magic.

ds: A dense, muscular-looking stone from the Mysterious realm, heavy and warm, flexing slightly when gripped hard.
effect: You gain +1 to Strength and Constitution checks. Once per short rest, you gain advantage on one Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check.

ds: A hard, wedge-shaped stone from the Outer Realm, its point never dulling no matter how many rocks it breaks.
effect: Your attacks deal double damage to objects and structures. Once per long rest, you tunnel through 30 feet of stone in one turn. Your weapon attacks ignore AC from armor once per short rest.

ds: A sickly green-black stone from Heaven, with spots of rot spreading across its surface. It makes anyone near it feel feverish.
effect: When you hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution save or become poisoned for 1 minute. Once per long rest, you spread sickness in a 30-foot radius.

ds: A flat, layered stone from Heaven, each layer a different shade, like slices of distant worlds pressed together.
effect: Once per long rest, you and up to six allies can shift to another plane for 1 minute. You gain resistance to damage from creatures not native to your plane.

ds: A cluster of round stones from Heaven that slowly orbit one another without touching, held by some invisible pull.
effect: Once per long rest, you summon three orbiting stones for 1 minute. Each round, they strike a creature within 30 feet for 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

ds: A glowing, violet-white stone from the Outer Realm, so hot it never stops crackling and burning faintly.
effect: When you hit, you deal an extra 1d6 radiant damage. Once per short rest, you fire a plasma beam 120 feet long, 10 feet wide; creatures take 6d6 damage, DC 18 Dexterity save halves.

ds: A dark green stone from Heaven, slick and sweating a thin bitter liquid. Plants wilt where it is set down.
effect: When you hit, you deal an extra 1d6 poison damage. Once per short rest, a creature you hit must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 minute.

ds: A soft yellow stone from the Inner Realm dusted with golden pollen. Flowers bloom wherever its dust falls.
effect: Once per long rest, you release a pollen cloud in a 30-foot radius. Allies regain 4d8 hit points and enemies must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 minute.

ds: A plain, smooth stone from the Primordial realm that hums with endless untapped energy, though it never shows its full shape.
effect: Once per long rest, you gain proficiency in all skills and saves for 1 hour. You may also gain one feat or ability of your choice for that time.

ds: A perfectly cut crystal from the Inner Void, its edges so exact they slice light into neat beams.
effect: Your critical hits occur on a roll of 18 to 20. Once per short rest, you can turn a missed attack into a hit.

ds: A clear, glass-like stone from Hell that shows only the exact moment it is looked at, never before or after.
effect: Once per long rest, you take an extra action on your turn. Creatures cannot have advantage on attack rolls against you.

ds: A smooth, pale stone from Heaven that never ages or weathers. Anything wrapped with it stays fresh for years.
effect: Your weapons and armor cannot be damaged or destroyed. Once per long rest, you stop a dying creature from decaying or losing hit points for 24 hours.

ds: A tall, regal violet crystal that stands upright on its own, found in Outer Realm palace ruins where it glows brighter whenever anyone nearby boasts aloud.
effect: Once per long rest, you and up to six allies within 60 feet gain advantage on saves against fear and charm for 1 minute and deal an extra 1d6 damage on hits.

ds: A pale grey pebble speckled with dots that shift count each time you look, found loose in Human-realm riverbeds near gambling towns and crossroads.
effect: Once per long rest, after you see the result of a d20 roll you make, you may add or subtract 1 from it, possibly turning a failure into a success.

ds: A smooth, dense iron-grey stone with streaks pointing one way, found in Hell's launching fields where it hums and tugs forward when held in a throwing hand.
effect: While equipped, your thrown weapons and ranged spell attacks gain 30 feet of range, and once per short rest a thrown or fired hit deals an extra 1d6 force damage.

ds: A layered, armor-plate gray stone with a faint gold sheen, mined in Heaven's fortress hills where it hardens into overlapping scales as it cools.
effect: Set into armor, it grants +1 AC. Once per short rest, when you take damage, reduce it by 2d6 as the plates flare around the struck spot.

ds: A broad, milky white stone whose inner glow forms a soft dome, gathered from Heaven's temple foundations where it lies beneath every older ward.
effect: Once per long rest, as a reaction when a creature within 30 feet is hit, grant it a barrier that reduces that damage and all damage until your next turn by 2d6.

ds: A deep crimson heart-shaped crystal that beats with a slow, audible throb, found only in the Inner Void where its rhythm shakes loose dust around it.
effect: While equipped, you sense the heartbeat of every living creature within 120 feet. Once per long rest, stop a creature's pulse: DC 20 Constitution save or drop to 0 hit points.

ds: A heavy bronze stone etched with chain-like veins that tighten when touched, found in Heaven's courts of judgment beneath the seats where oaths are sworn.
effect: When you hit a creature bound by a pact, curse, or chain, deal an extra 1d6 radiant damage. Once per long rest, it also must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or be stunned until your next turn.

ds: A flawless white stone that repels dirt and blood alike, found in clear Heaven springs where nothing else grows and no stain ever settles on it.
effect: While equipped, you have advantage on saves against poison, disease, and curses. Once per long rest, end one curse or poison affecting a creature you touch.

ds: A shifting stone that shows a different face to every viewer, mirroring their own bloodline in its grain, found deep in the Inner Void among forgotten first ancestors.
effect: Once per long rest, for 1 hour you gain one innate racial trait of a lineage you have seen, such as darkvision, a breath weapon, or natural flight at 30 feet.

ds: A blood-red stone veined with black cracks that run hot to the touch, found in Heaven's war grounds where its glow surges whenever a fight breaks out.
effect: Once per long rest, enter a fury for 1 minute: gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and deal an extra 1d6 damage with melee hits, but you cannot cast spells.

ds: A translucent blue-grey stone always beaded with water, gathered from Heaven's cloud-fed lakes where it drips steadily and steams when set near any flame.
effect: Once per long rest, call rain in a 30-foot radius for 1 minute: fires are doused, the area is lightly obscured, and enemies inside have disadvantage on ranged attacks. Also hits deal 1d6 cold.

ds: A dull gold stone with a hollow center that seems to grip whatever is placed inside, found in Hell's vaults and tollhouses buried under sealed debts.
effect: Once per long rest, when you hit a creature, seize one item it holds or wears unless it succeeds on a DC 15 Strength save; it stays held until the creature meets a price you name.

ds: A stone so plain it is hard to notice, yet everything near it looks sharper and more solid, found only in the Void where all other laws thin out.
effect: Once per long rest, declare one illusion, transformation, or spell effect within 120 feet false; it ends unless its creator succeeds on a DC 22 save of their casting ability.

ds: A cracked black stone shot through with red sparks that flare when commands are given nearby, found in the Outer Realm under the rubble of fallen thrones.
effect: While equipped, you are immune to being charmed or commanded. Once per long rest, end every control effect on allies within 60 feet, and each may make one weapon attack as a reaction.

ds: A green and grey stone that slowly sheds an outer skin to reveal fresh color beneath, found in Hell's underground gardens among seeds that sprout in darkness.
effect: Once per long rest, when you would drop to 0 hit points, you instead drop to 1 hit point, regain 2d6 hit points, and lose one level of exhaustion.

ds: A rubbery, deep blue stone that springs back from any blow, found in the Inner Realm wedged in canyon walls that echo every sound three times.
effect: Once per short rest, when you take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, halve it and deal the other half back to the attacker if it is within 60 feet.

ds: A silver stone etched with faint circles that refill like ink after fading, found on Heaven's study towers where spent magic drifts down like dust.
effect: Once per long rest, after you cast a spell of 3rd level or lower, regain the spell slot used, letting you cast it again without spending a new slot.

ds: A flat, layered stone covered in tiny script that rearranges into instructions, found in the Chaos realm inside ruined alchemist halls and boiling mineral pools.
effect: While equipped, you have advantage on alchemy and herbalism checks. Once per long rest, brew a potion you have tasted in 10 minutes without spending any materials.

ds: A paired stone, two identical halves fused along a seam, found in Heaven's foundries where every gear and beam is built with a hidden spare.
effect: Once per long rest, when you fail a saving throw or a spell or item you use would fail, you may roll the save again or have the effect work anyway.

ds: A thin, glassy silver stone with a perfect mirror face, found in still Human-realm ponds and on polished cliff faces that catch the morning sun.
effect: Once per long rest, as a reaction when a ranged spell attack misses you, redirect it at a creature within 30 feet, using the same attack roll.

ds: A soft green stone that slowly regrows any chip broken from it, found in Hell's fungus caverns where severed roots knit back together overnight.
effect: While equipped, at the start of each of your turns you regain 1d4 hit points if you have at least 1 hit point and are below half your maximum.

ds: A stone that never stays in one place, slipping free of any setting not shaped by a master, found loose in the Void where bindings have broken.
effect: While equipped, you cannot be restrained or grappled. Once per long rest, shatter every binding, chain, prison, or sealing effect within 60 feet, freeing whatever it held, friend or foe.

ds: A heavy, dark grey stone that refuses to be moved once set down, found in Hell's quiet catacombs holding doors and coffins exactly shut.
effect: While equipped, you cannot be pushed, pulled, knocked prone, or teleported against your will. Once per long rest, become immune to all damage until your next turn but cannot move.

ds: A banded orange stone whose patterns loop endlessly, found in the Inner Realm in caves where every echo and footstep repeats itself a heartbeat later.
effect: Once per short rest, after you take the Attack action or cast a spell of 3rd level or lower, repeat that exact action as a bonus action at no extra cost.

ds: A cube-shaped grey stone with faint pips on each face, found in Human-realm creek gravel near gaming houses and roadside dice tables.
effect: Once per long rest, after you roll any die, you may reroll it and use either result.

ds: A dull brown stone that dents but never cracks, found in Human-realm quarries where it absorbs hammer blows that would split ordinary rock.
effect: While equipped, choose one damage type after each long rest; you reduce damage of that type you take by 2.

ds: A pale gold stone with a dark core, warm and cold at once, found in Hell's deepest tombs where the line between life and death runs thin.
effect: Once per long rest, touch a creature that died within the last minute; it returns with 1 hit point, but you take 2d6 necrotic damage that cannot be reduced.

ds: A blackened stone with one bright red fleck that always points toward a single person, found in Hell's battlefields where the betrayed were buried.
effect: Once per long rest, name a creature that harmed you or an ally; for 1 hour your hits against it deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage and you always know its direction.

ds: A spiral stone that turns the opposite way from any spin it is given, found in Human-realm caves where dripping water seems to climb back upward.
effect: Once per long rest, touch a small object or a wound; undo the last minute of change to it, repairing a broken item or restoring 1d6 hit points just lost.

ds: A grey and white stone streaked as if blown by wind, found in Human-realm horse plains and along old caravan roads worn deep by hooves.
effect: While equipped, your mount gains +10 feet of speed and you have advantage on checks to stay mounted. Once per long rest, up to four allies move with you as you move.

ds: A perfect circle of pale stone with no visible seam or start, found in Primordial depths where it orbits other laws like a planet's halo.
effect: While equipped, you may attune to one extra magic item. Once per long rest, store a spell of up to 5th level in the ring and cast it later as a bonus action.

ds: A knotted brown stone threaded with fine living tendrils, found in the Abyss beneath world-sized trees where it anchors the oldest growth.
effect: Once per short rest, roots burst from the ground in a 20-foot radius; creatures of your choice there must succeed on a DC 17 Strength save or be restrained for 1 minute.

ds: A mottled green and black stone, soft and damp to the touch, found in Hell's swamps where every plant around it has withered into slime.
effect: When you hit a plant creature or wooden object, deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage. Once per long rest, wither all ordinary plants in a 30-foot radius into rot.

ds: A slick, oily amber stone that leaves a warm sheen on skin, found in the Abyss near healing pools and old ointment makers' cellars.
effect: As an action, rub the stone on a touched creature: it regains 1d6 hit points and ends one poison or burn. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.

ds: A square, slate-grey stone carved by nature into ruled lines, found in the Inner Realm in the halls of ancient councils and guild houses.
effect: Once per long rest, declare a rule within 60 feet for 1 minute, such as no flying; any creature that breaks it takes 1d6 psychic damage each time (DC 18 Wisdom save negates).

ds: A curved, steel-blue crystal shaped like a crescent, found in the Inner Void where old sword strikes left cuts in empty space.
effect: While equipped, you always act first in initiative order on the first round. Once per short rest, your first melee hit in a fight deals an extra 1d6 slashing damage and is a critical hit.

ds: A deep blue tear-shaped stone, cold and always slightly wet, found in Heaven's mourning gardens where it weeps faintly when grief is near.
effect: Once per long rest, a creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or be overcome with grief for 1 minute, unable to take reactions and moving at half speed.

ds: A clear stone with a faint ring of light that sweeps around its edge, found in Human-realm watchtower foundations and guard posts along borders.
effect: Once per short rest, as an action, learn whether any hidden or invisible creatures are within 30 feet, though not where or what they are.

ds: A rough, raised stone in pale pink ridges like healed flesh, found in the Chaos realm where old wounds in the land have closed over.
effect: While equipped, after you take damage from a creature, you reduce further damage of that type from it by 2 for 1 minute. Once per long rest, regain 2d6 hit points.

ds: A porous tan stone that holds smells for days, found in Human-realm forests along game trails and inside hunting lodges.
effect: While equipped, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Survival checks using smell, and can track a creature by scent for up to 1 day after it passed.

ds: A cold, glossy black stone with a faint sneer-shaped crack, found in the Chaos realm in ruined halls of exiles and outcasts.
effect: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, scorn a creature within 60 feet; it takes 1d6 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll against anyone but you.

ds: A spiral-grooved metallic stone that turns itself slowly when set down, found in Outer Realm machine ruins jammed into giant broken engines.
effect: Once per long rest, bind a creature you hit: DC 21 Strength save or it is pinned in place, restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each turn.

ds: A crescent-shaped grey stone with a sharp inner edge, found in Human-realm farm fields after harvest and in smithies making reaping tools.
effect: When you hit with a slashing weapon, deal 1 extra damage. Once per long rest, make one melee attack against every creature within 5 feet of you.

ds: A stone whose color drifts through green, gold, brown, and white over a year, found in Heaven's high meadows where four winds meet.
effect: Once per long rest, impose a season in a 30-foot radius for 1 minute, such as winter (difficult terrain and 1d6 cold per turn) or summer (fire resistance for allies).

ds: A rose-pink stone with a soft, warm glow that seems to lean toward whoever looks at it, found in Heaven's garden pavilions near lovers' fountains.
effect: While equipped, you have advantage on Persuasion checks. Once per long rest, a creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or be charmed by you for 1 hour.

ds: A milky stone with a faint shape moving inside like a thought, found in the Inner Realm where old tools and statues began to think.
effect: Once per long rest, awaken an object or weapon for 1 hour; it can speak, sense within 60 feet, and grants you advantage on initiative and on Perception checks.

ds: A stone split cleanly through the middle yet never falling apart, found in Heaven's sky canyons where land and air were first pulled apart.
effect: Once per long rest, touch a creature or object to sunder a fusion, transformation, or possession; it ends, and the target takes 2d6 force damage.

ds: A pale lavender stone that is always perfectly still and calm to hold, found in Mysterious-realm mountain shrines and silent lakeshores.
effect: While equipped, you have advantage on saves against fear. Once per long rest, as an action, end the frightened condition on yourself and allies within 15 feet.

ds: A grey stone collared by a dark band, heavy with the weight of obedience, found in the Inner Void in abandoned workhouses of the first empires.
effect: Once per long rest, a creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom save or obey your commands for 1 hour; it repeats the save when harmed.

ds: A dark, nearly weightless stone that throws no shadow of its own, found in Hell's twilight forests where light never fully reaches the ground.
effect: While equipped, you have advantage on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness. Once per short rest, become heavily obscured to others until the end of your next turn.

ds: A smoky black stone that seems to be only a shape rather than a solid thing, found in Heaven's grave hills where corpse shadows linger.
effect: Once per long rest, become a living shadow for 1 minute: attacks against you have disadvantage and you can move through spaces as narrow as 1 inch.

ds: A green stone crossed with feather-like patterns that rustle faintly, found in Heaven's spirit groves where ancestral voices whisper among old trees.
effect: While equipped, you can see and speak with spirits within 60 feet. Once per long rest, call an ancestor spirit to grant you or an ally a 1d6 bonus on every save for 1 minute.

ds: A stone that changes color and texture to match whatever it touches, found in Human-realm marshes where nothing looks quite the same twice.
effect: Once per long rest, take the shape of a beast or humanoid you have seen for 1 hour; you keep your own mind and hit points but gain its movement modes.

ds: A thick, round iron-grey stone with a raised rim, found in Outer Realm forge mountains alongside veins of iron and steel.
effect: Set into a shield or armor, it grants +2 AC. Once per short rest, as a reaction, block one attack that would hit you, taking no damage.

ds: A jagged yellow-white stone that snaps with tiny sparks when touched, found in Hell's storm caverns where static builds in the stale air.
effect: When you hit a creature, deal an extra 1d6 lightning damage. Once per short rest, it must also succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or lose its reaction until its next turn.

ds: A tiny, dense stone that looks smaller each time it is measured, found in Primordial depths where distance and length shrink to nothing.
effect: Once per long rest, shorten any distance or duration you choose: teleport up to 1 mile you can see, or cut the remaining duration of one effect to 1 round.

ds: A bright orange stone that pulses with flashes of light, found on Heaven's beacon peaks and messenger towers where it blinks in pairs.
effect: While equipped, you can send a one-sentence message to an ally within 1 mile. Once per long rest, emit a flare that blinds creatures within 30 feet that fail a DC 14 Constitution save for 1 round.

ds: A tiny black stone that drags light, dust, and sound into itself, found in the Inner Realm at the bottom of collapsed starfall craters.
effect: Once per long rest, create a point of collapse within 120 feet; creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Strength save or be pulled to it and take 1d6 force damage.

ds: A hollow, tube-shaped dark green stone that feels faintly cold, found in the Abyss inside old thieves' tunnels and drained wells.
effect: When you hit a creature, you regain hit points equal to half the extra 1d6 necrotic damage you deal. Once per long rest, steal one spell slot of 4th level or lower from a creature you hit.

ds: A pale bone-white stone porous like old marrow, found in Mysterious-realm ossuaries and graveyards where bones lie close to the surface.
effect: Once per long rest, raise a corpse within 30 feet as a skeleton servant for 1 hour; it obeys you, fights with simple weapons, and cannot use magic or skills.

ds: A flat, smooth grey stone that never quite touches whatever it rests on, found in the Outer Realm skipping across still lakes of silver mist.
effect: Once per short rest, skip a moment and teleport up to 60 feet to a spot you can see. Once per long rest, skip one failed save, treating it as a success.

ds: A white stone naturally shaped like a small skull, with dark pits for eyes, found in Outer Realm battle grounds and summoners' trophy halls.
effect: While equipped, undead and summoned creatures have disadvantage on attacks against you. Once per long rest, a creature you kill rises as your servant for 1 hour.

ds: A pale blue stone that shows drifting clouds within it, found on Heaven's highest peaks above the weather line where only wind can reach.
effect: While equipped, you take no falling damage. Once per long rest, gain a flying speed of 60 feet for 10 minutes and call a gust that pushes creatures 20 feet away.

ds: A heavy, dull grey stone that drains the will to lift it, found in Primordial hollows where nothing has moved since the first age.
effect: Once per long rest, creatures you choose within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom save or lose their will to act, taking only one action per turn and no reactions for 1 minute.

ds: A thick amber stone in which trapped bubbles drift very slowly, found in Outer Realm tar pits and ancient resin swamps.
effect: When you hit a creature, its speed is halved until your next turn. Once per long rest, slow every enemy within 30 feet for 1 minute (DC 18 Constitution save negates).

ds: A tiny, perfectly formed stone that keeps getting smaller in the eye, found in the Abyss in narrow cracks no larger than a finger.
effect: Once per short rest, shrink yourself or a willing creature to Tiny size for 1 minute, gaining advantage on Stealth and the ability to slip through 1-inch gaps.

ds: A rough brown stone with a strong earthy odor, found in the Chaos realm near beast lairs and hunting grounds thick with old trails.
effect: While equipped, you can smell creatures within 60 feet, including invisible ones, and know their direction. You have advantage on checks to track by smell.

ds: A soft white stone that crumbles into flakes and reforms in silence, found in Heaven's high valleys where snow falls without wind.
effect: While equipped, you leave no tracks and ignore snow and ice terrain. Once per long rest, snow falls in a 30-foot radius for 1 minute, muffling sound and slowing enemies by 10 feet.

ds: A flickering stone that is sometimes visible and sometimes not, found in Hell's unstable caverns that appear only on certain nights.
effect: Once per long rest, roll a d6 at the start of your turn for 1 minute; on a 4 or higher, your next attack deals an extra 1d6 damage or your next spell's DC rises by 2.

ds: A deep purple stone crowned with gold veins, found in Heaven's throne halls where its presence makes all others bow their heads.
effect: While equipped, you have advantage on Persuasion and Intimidation checks. Once per long rest, command creatures within 30 feet to kneel; DC 15 Wisdom save or be knocked prone.

ds: A clear stone in which space appears folded, with edges that seem too close and too far at once, found in Human-realm caves with odd echoes.
effect: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

ds: A long, thin grey stone ending in a sharp natural point, found in Heaven's training grounds and buried along the paths of ancient phalanxes.
effect: While equipped, your reach with spears increases by 5 feet. Once per short rest, a thrown spear deals an extra 1d6 piercing damage and returns to your hand.

ds: A translucent pale blue stone that feels faintly cold and hollow, found in Human-realm haunted ruins and old battlefields after midnight.
effect: Once per long rest, for 1 minute you can move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain, taking 1d6 force damage if you end your turn inside one.

ds: A smooth golden stone that hums with the faint sound of a voice, found in Heaven's lecture halls and the amphitheaters of poets.
effect: While equipped, you can understand any spoken language. Once per long rest, your words command attention: creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or be stunned for 1 round.

ds: A sleek silver stone streaked as if in motion, found in Heaven's racetracks and along mountain paths worn smooth by runners.
effect: While equipped, your walking speed increases by 10 feet. Once per long rest, take an extra action on your turn, limited to a single attack, Dash, or Disengage.

ds: A round stone with spiral bands that turns slowly on its own, found in Heaven's windswept towers and the eye of small whirlwinds.
effect: When you hit with a weapon, deal an extra 1d6 damage as it spins. Once per long rest, spin a creature or object within 30 feet: DC 15 Strength save or be knocked prone and dizzy.

ds: A warm, ivory stone that glows faintly when held by someone who trains, found in Human-realm monasteries and old martial dojos.
effect: Once per long rest, focus your inner spirit to gain +1 to attack rolls and add 1d4 to damage rolls for 1 minute.

ds: A stone naturally cracked into two matching halves, found in Human-realm dagger smithies and on cliffs split by lightning.
effect: Once per long rest, when you hit with a dagger or light weapon, split the strike to also hit a second creature within 5 feet for the same damage.

ds: A perfectly balanced grey stone that never rolls or tips, found in the Inner Void where it holds broken laws together like a keystone.
effect: Once per long rest, touch a creature or object to stabilise it: end one curse, failing fusion, or pact effect, or bring a dying creature to full hit points.

ds: A dense white-gold crystal that glows from within and stays hot to the touch, mined from scorched craters in the Outer Realm where fallen stars burned out.
effect: Once per short rest, you release a burst of starfire in a 30-foot radius. Creatures of your choice take 2d6 radiant and 2d6 fire damage and are blinded until your next turn, DC 19 Constitution save halves and negates blindness.

ds: Pale blue glassy shards that hold a faint shimmer even in total darkness, found in cold Abyssal caverns open to a sky of distant stars.
effect: While equipped, you shed dim light 20 feet and see through magical darkness. Once per short rest, a beam of starlight deals 2d6 radiant damage to a creature within 120 feet and reveals invisible creatures near it.

ds: A grey, grainy stone that crackles and hisses when held, its surface crawling with flickering specks, found in silent fields of the Inner Void.
effect: Once per short rest, fill a 60-foot sphere with static for 1 minute. Creatures inside cannot communicate by speech or telepathy and must pass a DC 22 Constitution save to cast spells, taking 2d6 thunder on a failure.

ds: A polished blue-grey ore streaked with silver bands, harder than any forged blade, dug from iron-choked veins deep in the Inner Realm.
effect: While equipped, you gain +1 AC and resistance to slashing damage from nonmagical weapons. Once per long rest, when hit by a weapon attack, reduce the damage by 4d6 and the attacker's weapon cracks.

ds: A dark grey stone laced with crackling white veins that smells of rain, gathered from the windswept peaks of Heaven during thunderstorms.
effect: Once per short rest, call down lightning on a point within 60 feet. Creatures in a 10-foot radius take 2d6 lightning and 1d6 thunder damage and are pushed 10 feet, DC 15 Dexterity save halves and negates the push.

ds: A heavy, rust-red ore with thick ridged grain that feels warm under the hand, quarried from the training grounds of heroic gods in Heaven.
effect: While equipped, your carrying capacity doubles and you have advantage on Strength checks. Once per short rest, add 1d6 to a melee damage roll and shove the target 10 feet if it is Large or smaller.

ds: A cracked, ash-colored stone that hums with a tight, uneasy tension and tends to fracture under pressure, found in the crushing depths of the Outer Realm.
effect: Once per short rest, you load a creature within 60 feet with crushing strain. It takes 2d6 psychic damage and gains 2 levels of exhaustion for 1 minute, DC 21 Constitution save halves and negates exhaustion.

ds: A smooth black stone that looks slightly smaller each time you glance away, found in hollow, half-empty chambers in the vaults of Heaven.
effect: Once per short rest, when a creature within 60 feet makes an attack roll, save, or check, you subtract 1d6 from the roll. Once per long rest, subtract 2d6 instead.

ds: A bright golden stone with a laurel-like grain that catches the light at every angle, found atop victory altars and finish lines in Heaven.
effect: Once per long rest, when you fail an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can treat it as a success instead. Recharges early whenever you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points.

ds: A blazing orange-gold crystal that radiates steady warmth and light, quarried from the sun-facing cliffs of Heaven where shadows never fall.
effect: While equipped, you shed bright light 20 feet. Once per short rest, flare it as an action: creatures within 20 feet take 2d6 radiant damage and are blinded until your next turn, DC 15 Constitution save halves and negates.

ds: A soft, mottled green-brown stone slick with moss and smelling of rot, dredged from the drowned groves of Heaven's marshlands.
effect: Once per short rest, turn a 20-foot square of ground within 60 feet into sucking mire for 1 minute. It is difficult terrain, and creatures entering must pass a DC 15 Strength save or be restrained.

ds: A nearly weightless, pale translucent stone that drifts slightly when dropped, found blown into high crags and cliffside nests in the Mysterious realm.
effect: While equipped, you take no falling damage from 30 feet or less. Once per long rest, gain a flying speed of 30 feet for 1 minute and disengage as a bonus action.

ds: A green stone grown through with living roots and moss that never wither, found where vines and trees knot together in Heaven's gardens.
effect: Once per short rest, bind yourself to a willing creature within 30 feet for 1 minute. Whenever either of you regains hit points, the other regains 1d6, and you share advantage on concentration saves.

ds: A perfectly mirrored crystal whose halves are identical down to every flaw, found split cleanly in two in the strange caves of the Mysterious realm.
effect: Once per long rest, when a creature within 30 feet deals damage to you, it takes 1d6 force damage plus half the damage it dealt, DC 13 Constitution save for half.

ds: A hungry dark violet stone with hooked ridges that seems to pull at nearby objects, found in the oldest grasping deeps of the Primordial realm.
effect: Once per short rest, seize from a creature within 120 feet: steal one object it holds, or take 2d6 necrotic damage worth of life as temporary hit points, DC 27 Constitution save negates. Once per long rest, take one spell slot.

ds: A smooth, warm brown pebble with a soft leather sheen, often found worn smooth along herding trails and stockyards in the Human realm.
effect: Once per long rest, you can charm a Beast within 30 feet for 1 hour, DC 12 Wisdom save negates. While charmed, it obeys your simple commands.

ds: A salt-white crystal with a faint tang on the tongue that changes with what is near it, mined from mineral springs in the Inner Realm.
effect: While equipped, you automatically detect poisons, diseases, and potions by taste without harm. Once per short rest, you can sample a creature's blood to learn its type, resistances, and current hit points, and gain advantage on your next attack against it.

ds: A dull metallic grey stone etched with regular grooves like gears or circuitry, found in old mine workings and forges of the Human realm.
effect: While equipped, you are proficient with tinker's tools and can repair a broken mundane device in 1 minute. Once per long rest, add 1d4 to a check to build, operate, or disable a mechanism.

ds: A soft lavender stone that whispers faint thoughts when held near the temple, found in the silent, thought-filled drift of the Void.
effect: While equipped, you can speak telepathically with any creature within 1 mile. Once per short rest, read a creature's surface thoughts and deal 2d6 psychic damage, DC 23 Wisdom save negates both.

ds: A banded stone whose faint pulse beats like a slow drum, found in caverns that echo with rhythm in the Mysterious realm.
effect: Once per short rest, you set a tempo for 1 minute: your speed increases by 10 feet and you gain +1 to initiative and Dexterity saves while you keep moving each turn.

ds: A layered stone banded with soil, sand, clay, and rock in shifting strata, found where whole Abyssal landscapes have been reshaped overnight.
effect: Once per long rest, reshape terrain in a 100-foot square within 300 feet over 1 minute: raise or lower ground up to 30 feet, drain water, or create cover. Creatures caught take 1d6 bludgeoning, DC 18 Dexterity save negates.

ds: A black stone with a sly silver glint that is never quite where you left it, found in hidden robbers' caches across Heaven.
effect: Once per long rest, when you hit a creature, you can steal one magical effect on it or one known spell. You may use it once within 1 hour, DC 15 Wisdom save negates.

ds: A long, blade-thin sliver of grey stone that can slip through the narrowest cracks, found splintered in tight seams of the Chaos realm.
effect: While equipped, you can squeeze through any gap 1 inch wide. Once per short rest, your weapon attack ignores armor and shields, reducing the target's AC by 4 for that attack and dealing an extra 1d6 piercing.

ds: A sea-blue stone with silver crescent markings that rises and falls in weight with the moon, found on Heaven's tidal flats.
effect: Once per short rest, send a tidal surge in a 30-foot line. Creatures take 2d6 bludgeoning damage and are pulled up to 15 feet toward or away from you, DC 15 Strength save halves and negates.

ds: A clear crystal holding tiny grains that drift upward then down, frozen and moving at once, found in still, silent pockets of the Abyss.
effect: Once per long rest, take an extra action on your turn. Once per long rest, when a creature within 60 feet acts, you can act first with a single action, DC 18 Wisdom save or it loses that action.

ds: A smooth hourglass-shaped stone whose inner sand drifts slowly, found among old sundials and clock towers in the Human realm.
effect: Once per long rest, extend one ongoing spell or effect on you by 1 minute, or shorten a harmful condition on you by 1 round.

ds: A smooth, numbing black stone that feels like nothing at all when gripped, found in the dark, feeling-starved tunnels of the Abyss.
effect: While equipped, you sense vibrations to 30 feet. Once per short rest, numb yourself for 1 minute: gain resistance to all damage and ignore pain-based conditions, but you have disadvantage on Dexterity checks.

ds: A copper and brass flecked stone stamped with faint scale-like marks, found in markets and trading posts built along the trade roads of Hell.
effect: While equipped, you know the fair value of any item you hold. Once per short rest, strike a trade with a willing creature within 30 feet: swap one held item or 2d6 hit points, both receiving equal value.

ds: A worn, ancestral grey stone carved with faded family marks, found buried beneath old hearths and shrines in Heaven.
effect: While equipped, you have advantage on History checks about your culture. Once per long rest, call on ancestral practice to add 2d4 to an ability check or saving throw you are proficient in.

ds: A scarred, chipped ore that toughens a little each time it is struck, found in the practice yards and dueling grounds of the Inner Realm.
effect: While equipped, you gain proficiency in one weapon or skill of your choice after a long rest. Once per short rest, reroll a failed attack and add 1d6 to the new roll.

ds: A shifting stone whose color and shape change slowly when unwatched, found in the restless soil of the Human realm.
effect: Once per long rest, you can change your appearance or shift into a Small or Medium Beast for 1 minute, keeping your own hit points.

ds: A rainbow-banded crystal that flickers when another one nearby is touched, found at the edge of rainbows and signal towers in Heaven.
effect: Once per short rest, when you cast a spell or use a Rune effect, you can transmit it to originate from a willing creature or object you can see within 120 feet.

ds: A quicksilver-sheened stone that seems half metal and half crystal, found in the alchemists' deep labs of the Inner Realm.
effect: Once per short rest, transmute a nonmagical object up to 10 cubic feet into another material for 1 hour. Once per long rest, turn a creature's flesh to stone, taking 4d6 damage, DC 18 Constitution save negates.

ds: A glittering stone studded with tiny gold flecks and gem shards, found piled in hoards and dragon-sized vaults across Heaven.
effect: While equipped, you sense precious metals and gems within 60 feet. Once per long rest, find a hidden cache or item worth 2d6 x 10 gold in your surroundings.

ds: A dark grey stone marked with two crossed grooves like dueling blades, found in arenas and judgment halls of Heaven.
effect: Once per long rest, challenge a creature within 60 feet to a trial for 1 minute. You deal an extra 1d6 damage to it, and it has disadvantage attacking anyone but you, DC 15 Wisdom save negates.

ds: A soft, clear white stone that glows faintly when two people hold it, often found in places where vows were spoken in the Human realm.
effect: Once per long rest, bond with a willing creature for 1 hour. While within 30 feet, each of you gains +1 to saving throws.

ds: A clear white crystal that dims when lies are spoken near it, mined from the judgment halls and sacred springs of Heaven.
effect: While equipped, you know when a creature within 30 feet speaks a deliberate lie. Once per short rest, compel a creature to answer one question truthfully, DC 15 Wisdom save negates.

ds: A round stone that slowly rotates on its own when set down, found spinning in place within the drifting fields of the Void.
effect: Once per short rest, rotate a creature or object within 60 feet in place, turning it to face any direction and losing reactions until your next turn, DC 23 Strength save negates. Once per long rest, rotate a 30-foot area.

ds: A corkscrewed, spiral stone with sharp edges that seems wrung like cloth, found in rocky ravines of the Human realm.
effect: Once per long rest, when you hit a creature with a melee attack, twist your strike to deal an extra 1d4 bludgeoning damage, and the target drops one held item, DC 12 Strength save negates.

ds: A grey-blue spiral stone constantly misted with sea spray, found on Human-realm coasts after the strongest storms.
effect: Once per long rest, summon a 10-foot whirlwind of wind and water within 30 feet for 1 round. Creatures in it take 1d6 bludgeoning damage and are pushed 10 feet, DC 12 Strength save halves.

ds: A hazy, smoke-grey stone whose edges blur when looked at directly, found in shifting Inner Realm caves no map agrees on.
effect: Once per short rest, when a roll is made within 60 feet whose result is not yet known, you force it to be rolled twice and choose either result.

ds: A bone-white stone veined with dark green, cold and smelling of grave soil, found in the deepest crypt fields of the Inner Void.
effect: Once per long rest, raise up to six corpses within 60 feet as undead servants for 1 hour, each keeping its former hit points. Once per short rest, raise one corpse for 10 minutes.

ds: A clear blue stone that is always slightly damp and ripples like water, found in shifting springs and sea caves in the Chaos realm.
effect: While equipped, you can breathe underwater and swim at your walking speed. Once per short rest, become liquid for 1 minute: resistance to nonmagical damage, slip through any gap, and pass through enemies.

ds: A dark stone that shows nothing beneath its surface, found in places on the Human realm that defy any map or record.
effect: Once per long rest, roll 1d4 when you would take damage. On a 4, you take none of it.

ds: A brass-colored stone with small keyhole shaped hollows, found near opened vaults and broken gates in Heaven.
effect: While equipped, you have advantage on checks to open locks. Once per short rest, unlock any nonmagical lock within 30 feet. Once per long rest, end a magical seal or binding effect.

ds: A frayed, fibrous stone whose threads loosen when touched, found unwound and tangled in the far Outer Realm.
effect: Once per short rest, unravel a spell or magical effect within 120 feet, ending it, DC 21 Wisdom save negates. Once per long rest, unravel a creature's combined spell, dealing 2d6 force damage.

ds: A blood-red stone with a dark core that drinks light, found deep in the blood-soaked caverns of the Chaos realm.
effect: When you hit with a melee attack, you can drain 1d6 necrotic damage and regain hit points equal to the damage. Once per short rest, the drain deals 3d6 instead.

ds: A smooth grey stone that echoes faintly when spoken to, found in speaking halls and oracle caves of the Outer Realm.
effect: While equipped, spells you cast with only verbal components cost no material components and cannot be counterspelled. Once per short rest, cast a spell of up to 3rd level as a bonus action.

ds: A bright eye-shaped stone with a dark pupil-like center, found on high watchtowers and lookout peaks in Heaven.
effect: While equipped, you see clearly to 300 feet and gain darkvision to 60 feet. Once per short rest, see through invisibility and illusions within 60 feet for 1 minute.

ds: A spiral-patterned grey stone that hums softly and stirs the air around it, found in the swirling winds of the Mysterious realm.
effect: Once per short rest, create a 10-foot vortex within 60 feet for 1 round. Creatures in it take 1d6 bludgeoning damage and are pulled 10 feet toward its center, DC 13 Strength save halves.

ds: A weathered, compass-veined stone that always tips slightly toward home, found along long roads and sea routes in Heaven.
effect: While equipped, you never become lost and ignore exhaustion from travel. Once per long rest, you and up to six allies travel twice as far in a day without tiring.

ds: A heavy, square-cut grey stone with layered courses like a built wall, quarried from ancient ramparts in Hell.
effect: Once per short rest, raise a wall of stone up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick within 60 feet for 1 minute. It has AC 15 and 50 hit points.

ds: A battle-scarred stone the color of rust and dried blood, warm with the echo of clashing steel, found in ancient battlefields of Heaven.
effect: While equipped, you gain +1 to initiative and attack rolls. Once per short rest, when you hit a creature, deal an extra 2d6 damage and grant allies within 30 feet advantage on their next attack.

ds: A brittle, ashen stone that crumbles to dust when gripped, found in the dead, barren stretches of the Primordial realm.
effect: Once per short rest, wither a 30-foot radius: creatures take 2d6 necrotic damage and cannot regain hit points until your next turn, DC 27 Constitution save halves. Once per long rest, the area stays barren for 1 hour.

ds: A clear blue stone that feels cool and slightly wet, found in springs, wells, and river sources in Heaven.
effect: While equipped, you can breathe underwater and swim at your walking speed. Once per short rest, unleash a wave in a 30-foot cone, dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage and knocking creatures prone, DC 15 Strength save halves.

ds: A sea-green stone with rippled bands that ebb and flow in color, found along Heaven's shores and reefs.
effect: Once per short rest, send a wave in a 30-foot line. Creatures take 2d6 bludgeoning damage and are pushed 10 feet, DC 15 Strength save halves and negates the push.

ds: A heavy, gleaming gold-veined stone that feels rich in the hand, found in the treasuries and merchant halls of Heaven.
effect: While equipped, merchants offer you 10 percent better prices. Once per long rest, spend gold to add +1 to an ability check or saving throw for every 50 gold spent, up to +5.

ds: A fine, thread-veined stone woven through with colorful strands, found in sacred looms and spell halls of Heaven.
effect: Once per long rest, when you cast a spell, you can weave a second spell of 2nd level or lower into it, casting both with one action.

ds: A pale, frostbitten stone with hollow pits that draws warmth from your hand, found in the starving frozen wastes of the Outer Realm.
effect: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, regain 2d6 hit points and gain +1 to damage rolls for 1 hour, stacking up to +5. Once per long rest, devour a corpse to regain all hit points.

ds: A dark blue stone always beaded with moisture, found in damp meadows and dew-covered fields of Heaven.
effect: Once per short rest, soak a 20-foot area within 60 feet. Fires are extinguished, and creatures there have vulnerability to cold and lightning damage until your next turn, DC 15 Dexterity save negates.

ds: A pure white stone that stays clean of any stain and reflects every light, found in pale, bleached caverns of Hell.
effect: While equipped, you have advantage on saves against being blinded. Once per short rest, flash white light in a 30-foot cone; creatures are blinded until your next turn, DC 15 Constitution save negates.

ds: A broad, flat slab of stone that seems to spread out when placed down, found across the wide plains of the Inner Realm.
effect: Once per short rest, widen the area of one spell or Rune effect you use by 15 feet, or make one melee attack hit every creature within reach.

ds: A deep blue stone with owl-eye flecks that calms the mind when held, found in temples and quiet libraries in Heaven.
effect: While equipped, you gain +1 to Wisdom saving throws. Once per short rest, add 1d6 to an Insight, Perception, or Arcana check to read a Law or spell.

ds: A shimmering, prismatic stone that never looks the same twice, found only by chance and never twice in the same place in the Abyss.
effect: Once per long rest, make a small wish: reroll any one die rolled within 60 feet, or cast a spell of 3rd level or lower that you know without a slot. Roll 1d6; on a 1, the stone goes dormant for 1d4 days.

ds: A smooth grey stone with faint letters drifting under its surface, found in scriptoriums and poets' graves in Heaven.
effect: Once per short rest, speak a word of power to a creature within 30 feet: it is frightened, charmed, or deafened until your next turn, DC 15 Wisdom save negates.

ds: A heavy, layered stone holding tiny mountains, seas, and forests inside it, found in the deep foundations of the Void.
effect: While equipped, you always know your location and direction. Once per long rest, reshape the land within 1 mile for 1 hour: raise mountains, form rivers, or level ground. Creatures caught take 4d6 bludgeoning, DC 25 Dexterity save halves.

ds: A warm golden stone covered in faint prayer marks that glows brighter with devotion, found in ancient Inner Void temples.
effect: Once per short rest, call on devotion: you and allies within 60 feet regain 3d6 hit points and gain advantage on saving throws for 1 minute. Once per long rest, restore a god's or ally's expended spell slots.

ds: A translucent, smoke-grey stone that feels cold and partly intangible when held, found in empty Void chambers where spirits linger.
effect: Once per short rest, become incorporeal for 1 minute: pass through objects, gain resistance to all nonmagical damage, and drain 2d6 necrotic damage with a touch, DC 23 Constitution save negates.

ds: A bright white stone with a small dark dot near its center, warm and lively in the hand, found in sunlit Heaven fields.
effect: Once per short rest, gain a surge of yang: add 1d6 radiant damage to your attacks and gain +10 feet speed for 1 minute. Doubled if a creature holding Yinstone is within 30 feet.

ds: A dark black stone with a small white dot near its center, cool and still in the hand, found in shadowed Heaven groves.
effect: Once per short rest, gain a wave of yin: regain 2d6 hit points and gain resistance to necrotic damage for 1 minute. Doubled if a creature holding Yangstone is within 30 feet.

ds: A fresh green stone that seems newer each day, found growing among the orchards and springs of Heaven.
effect: While equipped, you age at half the normal rate. Once per long rest, restore youth to a creature within 30 feet, removing 2 levels of exhaustion and restoring 2d6 hit points.

ds: A warm, pale green stone that carries a soft summer breeze, found on gentle hills and meadows of the Human realm.
effect: Once per long rest, call a warm west wind for 1 minute: your speed increases by 10 feet and ranged attacks against you have disadvantage.

ds: A perfectly round, hollow black ring of stone with nothing at its center, found in empty spaces in the Outer Realm.
effect: Once per short rest, reduce one number to zero: a creature's next damage roll, its speed until its next turn, or one bonus it applies, DC 21 Wisdom save negates.

ds: A greyish-green stone with rotting flesh-like texture and a faint smell of decay, found in shallow graves of the Mysterious realm.
effect: Once per long rest, raise a corpse within 30 feet as a zombie servant for 1 hour. It obeys simple commands and has half its former hit points.

ds: A polished steel-grey stone marked with a crest-like pattern that gleams in battle, found in Abyssal fortresses where oaths were sworn.
effect: While equipped, you gain +1 AC. Once per short rest, when an ally within 30 feet is hit, you can teleport to it and take the hit, reducing the damage by 3d6.
